title: Adding and Modifying an Index Tool Configuration

blocks.text: Adding an Index Tool configuration allows you to manage index templates that are used to create custom Exact Data Match (EDM) or Indexed Document Match (IDM) dictionaries and engines for Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
To add an Index Tool configuration:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Common Resources > Index Tool.
Click Add Index Tool Configuration.
The Add Index Tool Configuration drawer appears.
In the Add Index Tool Configuration drawer:
VM Name: Enter a unique name for the virtual machine (VM).
Status: Make sure that the VM is Enabled.
Enable Single Sign-On: Select Enabled or Disabled to configure single sign-on (SSO) for the Index Tool. When Enabled, the SSO Configurations section appears.
To learn how to configure the SSO Configurations section, see Configuring Single Sign-On for the Index Tool.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.

blocks.text: After you save, you can download the SSL certificate for the configuration from the Index Tool page or from the Edit Index Tool Configuration drawer.
To edit an Index Tool configuration:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > Common Resources > Index Tool.
Locate the Index Tool configuration in the table and click Edit.
The Edit Index Tool Configuration drawer appears.
In the Edit Index Tool Configuration drawer, you can do the following:
Status: Select Enabled or Disabled.
Enable Single Sign-On: Select Enabled to configure single sign-on (SSO). To learn how to configure the SSO Configurations section, see Configuring Single Sign-On for the Index Tool.
SSL Certificate: Click Download to download the certificate or click Regenerate SSL Certificate to replace the old certificate.
If you regenerate the certificate, ensure that you update the Index Tool virtual machine with the new file. To learn more, see Configuring the Index Tool with VMWare.
You cannot modify the VM Name.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.
